notion_target_surface.instructions: Given the Project Aegis Hub banner, Frozen Git mirror warning ('Not a tracker. Do not edit rows here'), Tasks DB schema, and cmano-clone wiki, which Notion surface(s) should the gap analysis evaluate and update for incomplete/missing requirements?

criteria.tasks_db_plus_wiki_drafts: Evaluate and remediate actionable requirement gaps in Notion Tasks DB (Project=Project Aegis, icon, Status, Note with Linear URL + source path + req IDs) and keep cmano-clone/Requirements drafts wiki current for narrative drafts; keep Frozen Git mirror (Requirements DB) strictly read-only.
criteria.requirements_db_and_tasks_db: Update Requirements DB (syncing missing requirement docs 22-27, SYM, PRD, etc.) AND maintain Tasks DB rows for open Linear gaps, explicitly overriding the Frozen Git mirror banner.
criteria.tasks_db_only: Evaluate and remediate in Tasks DB (Project=Project Aegis) only; leave both Frozen Git mirror and wiki untouched.
criteria.requirements_db_only: Evaluate and remediate only the Requirements DB inside Frozen Git mirror, ignoring Tasks DB.
criteria.other: None of the above fits; escalate to owner.

notion_frozen_mirror_respect.instructions: Should Frozen Git mirror and its inline Requirements DB remain strictly read-only (never mutated by M3 remediation) in accordance with its explicit 'Not a tracker. Do not edit rows here' banner?

criteria.true: Keep Frozen Git mirror read-only; do not edit rows in the July 2026 archive DB.
criteria.false: Allow M3 remediation to create or update rows inside Frozen Git mirror Requirements DB.

extraction_granularity.instructions: At what granularity should requirements be extracted from workspace markdown files into requirements-catalog.json to evaluate Linear and Notion backlog completeness?

criteria.req_id_clause_cluster: Extract per addressable requirement ID or cohesive capability-clause cluster (e.g. KCX-01, ENV-01, AME-6.11, RPL-29..31, SYM-MIL-01, P0-1, or section capability cluster where IDs are absent), yielding one testable single-outcome backlog unit per entry.
criteria.whole_document: Extract one coarse entry per markdown file (~35-45 entries total).
criteria.individual_sub_bullet: Extract every individual sub-bullet and acceptance checkbox (~1,500+ micro-items).

shipped_req_linear_rule.instructions: How should requirements already verified as shipped/implemented on main (with code, tests, or gate evidence, e.g. 01-21 MVP slices) be classified in Linear when no historical Backlog ticket exists for them, given linear-usage-contract.md s8 forbids backfilling ~350 shipped items?

criteria.complete_if_code_verified_no_backfill: Classify as complete (sub_status=shipped_verified) when backed by cited code/test/gate evidence or a Done DRG issue without creating redundant historical Linear Backlog tickets; flag only unshipped or partial residuals as incomplete/missing.
criteria.require_linear_ticket_for_all: Classify as missing unless a Linear issue exists for every shipped requirement and backfill historical Linear tickets.
criteria.exclude_shipped_from_catalog: Omit already-shipped requirements from requirements-catalog.json entirely.
criteria.other: Use a different rule for shipped requirements.

phase_n_deferred_rule.instructions: How should explicitly deferred Phase N requirements (10b Kessler/DEW, SWARM-27..30, REQ-09/10 matrix, ADR-023..026 deferred to 2027-01-15) be classified and remediated?

criteria.complete_when_tracked_deferred_backlog: Classify as complete (lifecycle_state=deferred_phase_n) when explicitly tracked in Linear Backlog and Notion target with [Phase N]/Deferred owner-gate markers and no Surface: line (matching DRG-112..117); classify as missing/incomplete only if untracked or missing deferral markers.
criteria.always_incomplete_until_shipped: Classify all Phase N deferred items as incomplete regardless of backlog tracking.
criteria.exclude_phase_n: Exclude Phase N items from the catalog and rubric.
criteria.other: Use a different rule for Phase N deferred items.

draft_docs_inclusion.instructions: How should Draft and Proposed requirement documents (drafts 23-27, SYM-MIL-01/SYM-CIV-01, CMD-38/39, 2026-09-30 reconciliation clauses, Milsim Comparative Research ENV..OPS) be treated in the backlog gap audit?

criteria.in_scope_backlog_preserve_draft: Include all Draft/Proposed requirements in scope; require Linear Backlog (no Surface:) and Notion tracking explicitly labeled Draft / owner-acceptance-pending (never promoting to Approved or Done); mark missing/incomplete if untracked or lacking source/AC/draft markers.
criteria.exclude_all_drafts: Exclude all Draft/Proposed documents until owner-approved.
criteria.require_approved_status_in_backlog: Mark all Draft documents incomplete until formally promoted to Approved even if tracked in Backlog.
criteria.other: Use a different rule for Draft/Proposed documents.

backlog_surface_line_rule.instructions: Under Project Aegis Rubrics s2(b)-(c) ('New requirements go in as Backlog with no Surface: line; only drg stamps Surfaces'), should Backlog requirement completeness omit the sprint-dispatch G2 Surface-stamp gate and forbid agents from adding Surface: lines?

criteria.true: Backlog intake completeness does not require a Surface: line; agents must never stamp Surface: on Backlog items.
criteria.false: Require a Surface: file list on every Backlog requirement item.

completeness_gate_model.instructions: What classification mechanism should separate complete, incomplete, and missing in Linear and Notion across M2-M4?

criteria.hybrid_prechecks_plus_jev_thresholds: Script-first two-stage gate: deterministic mechanical pre-checks run first (existence, source path on main, project isolation, required IDs/AC/cross-links, no agent Surface:, no fake Done, Notion Project+icon), followed by Jev System One (noul >= 0.80, choice confidence >= 0.50, score 0/1/2 aligned to S1-S6 >= 9/12 equivalent). Jev never overrides a failed mechanical pre-check.
criteria.jev_only_no_prechecks: Use Jev System One scores alone without deterministic mechanical pre-checks.
criteria.deterministic_regex_only: Use deterministic string/regex checks only without Jev evaluation.

low_confidence_escalation.instructions: When Jev returns choice.confidence < 0.50 or choice='other', should the evaluator flag needs_human_review=true and conservatively treat the item as incomplete rather than auto-marking complete?

criteria.true: Flag needs_human_review=true and do not auto-classify as complete when choice confidence < 0.50 or choice='other'.
criteria.false: Allow auto-marking complete even when choice confidence < 0.50.

backlog_rigor_level.instructions: Which rigor tier best calibrates Backlog gap evaluation for Project Aegis (given Backlog rubric pass 2026-10-29 and linear-usage-contract.md)?
criteria: minimal_existence_only — match any Linear/Notion title without source path, AC, or cross-link checks

balanced_intake_s1_s6_no_surface — require valid source path, req ID, testable AC or deferral note, lifecycle honesty, bidirectional Linear/Notion links, and S1-S6 >= 9/12 without dispatch-only Surface/PlayMode gates
full_dispatch_dor_with_surface — require drg Surface stamp and Play Mode human gate on every Backlog requirement
